description: Conservation mapped onto the PP_0908 propeller, axial and side views showing the invariant histidine cluster in the central channel
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection

af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q88PE2",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(af["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
rec=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
     for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM")]
A=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=["name","res","num","x","y","z"])
CA=A[A.name=="CA"].set_index("num")

txt=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/wwwapi/entry/pfam/PF07433/?annotation=alignment:full",timeout=300).text
seqs={}
for line in txt.splitlines():
    if not line or line.startswith(("#","//")): continue
    n,a=line.split(None,1); seqs[n]=seqs.get(n,"")+a.strip()
M=np.array([list(s) for s in seqs.values()]); AAs="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"
qn=[k for k in seqs if k.startswith("Q88PE2")][0]; qr=seqs[qn]; pos=int(qn.split("/")[1].split("-")[0])-1
cons={}
for j in range(M.shape[1]):
    if qr[j] in "-.": continue
    pos+=1
    c=Counter(x.upper() for x in M[:,j] if x.upper() in AAs); n=sum(c.values())
    f=np.array([c.get(a,0)/n for a in AAs]); H=-(f[f>0]*np.log2(f[f>0])).sum()
    cons[pos]=1-H/np.log2(20)

mat=CA.loc[30:]; P=mat[["x","y","z"]].values; ctr=P.mean(0)
w,v=np.linalg.eigh(np.cov((P-ctr).T)); axis=v[:,0]; e1=v[:,1]; e2=v[:,2]
proj=np.stack([(P-ctr)@e1,(P-ctr)@e2,(P-ctr)@axis],1)
cv=np.array([cons.get(i,np.nan) for i in mat.index])
SITE=np.array([0.,4.,0.]); sp=np.array([(SITE-ctr)@e1,(SITE-ctr)@e2,(SITE-ctr)@axis])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.2))
# A: down the axis
ax=axes[0]
segs=np.stack([proj[:-1,:2],proj[1:,:2]],1); good=~np.isnan(cv[:-1])
lc=LineCollection(segs[good],cmap="YlOrRd",array=cv[:-1][good],linewidths=2.2)
ax.add_collection(lc); ax.autoscale()
for r in [67,114,163,224,361]:
    p=CA.loc[r][["x","y","z"]].values-ctr; xy=(p@e1,p@e2)
    ax.plot(*xy,"o",ms=9,mfc="#2c3e50",mec="w",mew=1.2)
    ax.annotate(f"H{r}",xy,textcoords="offset points",xytext=(7,5),fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
p=CA.loc[359][["x","y","z"]].values-ctr
ax.plot(p@e1,p@e2,"s",ms=8,mfc="#16a085",mec="w"); ax.annotate("D359",(p@e1,p@e2),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,-12),fontsize=9,color="#16a085")
ax.plot(sp[0],sp[1],"*",ms=22,color="#7b1fa2",mec="w",mew=1.2)
ax.annotate("predicted metal site\n(1.2 A off the propeller axis)",(sp[0],sp[1]),
            textcoords="offset points",xytext=(8,-34),fontsize=9.5,color="#7b1fa2",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("angstrom"); ax.set_ylabel("angstrom")
ax.set_title("A  PP_0908 down the propeller axis, Ca trace\n     coloured by DUF1513 conservation",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.colorbar(lc,ax=ax,shrink=0.78,label="conservation (PF07433, 2078 sequences)")

# B: side view through the channel
ax=axes[1]
segs2=np.stack([proj[:-1][:,[0,2]],proj[1:][:,[0,2]]],1)
lc2=LineCollection(segs2[good],cmap="YlOrRd",array=cv[:-1][good],linewidths=2.0,alpha=0.85)
ax.add_collection(lc2); ax.autoscale()
cols={67:"#c0392b",114:"#e67e22",163:"#27ae60",224:"#2980b9",361:"#8e44ad",359:"#16a085"}
for r,c in cols.items():
    sc=A[(A.num==r)&(~A.name.isin(["N","C","O","CA"]))]
    q=(sc[["x","y","z"]].values-ctr)
    ax.scatter(q@e1,q@axis,s=46,color=c,zorder=5,edgecolors="w",linewidths=0.5)
    lab=("H" if r!=359 else "D")+str(r)
    ax.annotate(lab,((q@e1).mean(),(q@axis).mean()),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,6),
                fontsize=10,fontweight="bold",color=c,zorder=6)
ax.plot(sp[0],sp[2],"*",ms=24,color="#7b1fa2",mec="k",mew=0.6,zorder=7)
ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("angstrom (in plane)"); ax.set_ylabel("angstrom (along axis)")
ax.set_title("B  Side view: the six invariant side chains line a\n     354 angstrom^3 solvent-connected axial channel",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
